signals.usability_note: The house is visible but set back and partly obscured by trees and a mail truck in the right foreground; the frontage and yard are clearly shown.

provider_truck.detail: A USPS postal delivery vehicle (LLV) is stopped at the curb, but it is a routine mail delivery vehicle, not a home-services provider truck.

signals.notes: A small Cape-style house with light siding sits far back behind large trees, with a stone-ringed mulch bed near the curb, a wooden fence, and a white shed; the only vehicle out front is a USPS mail truck, and the neighboring house to the right has an oval sign on its facade.
